name: harvest-live
description: Harvest time tracking above the Claude Code prompt: suggests a project, task and description from the first prompt of each new chat and starts the timer in one press.

harvestToken.title: Harvest personal access token
harvestToken.description: Leave empty and connect from the Harvest band, or paste a token from https://id.getharvest.com/developers

harvestAccountId.title: Harvest account ID
harvestAccountId.description: Leave empty: found from your token when you connect in the band

workStart.title: Working hours start
workStart.description: From this time (HH:MM) the band opens on the first prompt of a new chat

workDays.title: Working days
workDays.description: Days the band opens by itself; /harvest works any time

demo.title: Demo mode
demo.description: Show made-up projects and timers instead of your Harvest account; nothing is sent to Harvest
